subject: OptimaHealth pilot incentive package — request for combined credits + discount
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@optimahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot scope + ask: combined credits and one-time discount

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for last week’s demo — the team was impressed with the latency and the console metrics. We’re ready to move forward with a 3-month technical pilot, but procurement is asking for an incentive package to justify the initial spend. Specifically: 

- $50k in free credits applied against pilot usage (one-time)
- 20% off list for the first 6 months if we convert to paid (applies to committed capacity)

We’ve attached a short SOW and a usage forecast to show expected token volumes. Our procurement team (cc’d) wants to understand whether these are standard concessions or if they need executive approval. Please let me know what you can do — we’re targeting an internal approval cycle by the end of next week.

Attachments: Optima_Health_Pilot_SOW.pdf (SOW), optima_usage_forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx (forecast)

Best,
Emily Chen
Head of ML Platforms
Optima Health

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot scope + ask: combined credits and one-time discount

Folks — forwarding an inbound from Optima Health. Ask: $50k free credits + 20% off first 6 months on conversion. Deal size if they convert looks like ~$250k ARR first year (see attached forecast).

Why I’m escalating: the credits + discount together exceed standard playbook for self-serve pilots. This is a strategic health system in our target vertical and could become a large customer across several teams. I propose we consider a blended package we can sign off quickly instead of a full exec-only concession:

- Option A (customer ask): $50k credits + 20% discount for 6 months (requires exec)
- Option B (our recommended): $35k credits + 15% discount on a 6-month committed conversion clause (requires leadership sign-off)

Requesting swift guidance from revenue and finance on the acceptable floor. If leadership signs off on Option B I’ll route legal + DocuSign and lock a canary contract.

Attachments included in thread: Optima_Health_Pilot_SOW.pdf, optima_usage_forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot scope + ask: combined credits and one-time discount

Alex — thanks for the heads up. I ran the numbers with Ben and here’s my take: Optima looks like a high-propensity account in healthcare (long-term TAM, cross-sell potential). I’m comfortable with a middle-ground concession that trades discount depth for a commitment. Proposed approval to escalate to Marissa for exec ok: 

- Approve $35k one-time pilot credit (applied over first invoice)
- Approve 15% transition discount for the first 3 paid months post-conversion (not 6)
- Require a minimum 6-month paid commit on conversion OR a $100k NDA (whichever secures revenue)

Reasoning: preserves margin while giving Optima a tangible ramp. If they insist on 20% for 6 months, that needs an executive exception.

If @Marissa signs off on the above, Alex can present Option B to Optima and we’ll prepare a quick amendment.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot scope + ask: combined credits + discount

Marissa / team — quick finance view. If we approve $35k credits + 15% for 3 months on a 6-month commit, modeled P&L impact over year 1 is ~6.2% gross margin reduction for that deal, recoverable over year 2 via expansion. Billing notes: credits will show as invoice credit line and need to be applied in the first billing cycle; discount to be built into pricing schedule for 3 months (flag for billing ops).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/OPTI-2026-3847 — I updated forecast and added amortization schedule in notes. Legal will need the exact discount clause language and we should include a rollback clause if usage < 50% of forecast after pilot.

Happy to take a quick call before you sign-off.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Pilot scope + ask: combined credits + discount — executive decision

Team — I reviewed the summary and Ben’s impact note. Optima is a strategic health system and getting the pilot live quickly drives product proof points and referenceability. I approve the middle-ground package with the following firm conditions: 

- Approve $35,000 one-time pilot credit to be applied to the first invoice.
- Approve 15% discount on list pricing for the first 3 paid months post-conversion.
- Require a signed 6-month paid commitment on conversion; if conversion does not happen within 90 days of pilot end, credits are forfeited.
- Include a usage rollback clause: if actual tokens consumed during pilot < 50% of forecast, discount is void and credits are reclaimed (billing ops to handle).

Alex: proceed to present Option B to Optima. Prepare amendment language with Legal and get the DocuSign envelope ready (cc procurement). Ben: confirm billing workflow and put the cost into the Q3 promotional budget. Lauren: once the amendment is signed, set a 30-day success check with CS.

Approved by,
Marissa Cole
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/s3/optima-pilot-offer-OPTI-3847
